content: Nehemia ese heitatao taudia e duanaidia
Maḡu vada e ahu, bona iduara vada na haginidia, bona ikoukou igimadia taudia bona ane-abi taudia bona Levi taudia vada na duanaidia murinai,
lau ese tadigu Hanani bona kohoro hekwara tauna Hanania na duanaidia, Ierusalem bae itaia tao; badina be ia ese heabidadama ai bona Dirava igari-henina ai hutuma na e hereadiava.

Bena na hamaorodia, nato, Ierusalem ikoukoudia basie kehodia ela bona dina na baine siahu, bona dounu igimadia e ginimu ai iduara na bae koudia bona auri amo bae ha-aukadia. Bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia bogaragidia amo hegima taudia ba duanaidia, ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai bona ta ta ena ruma ena ruma italaidia ai bae gima.
Hanua na lababa bona bada, a inoholaina taudia na dia hoho, bona ruma na do asie haginidia.
E lou taudia ladadia

Bena Dirava ese lalo-hadai ta lalogu ai e havaraia, Iohia taudia bona heilatao taudia bona orea taudia na baina haboudia, edia uru ta ta ai ladadia bae tore totona. Bena e dae ema guna taudia edia uru bukana na davaria. Una buka lalonai ini e torea toma:

Basileia taudia Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese e abidia mauri bona dauha e laohaidia bena edia noho-hedoa amo ma e lou mai taudia bini. Idia na Ierusalem bona Iuda e lou lao, ta ta ena hanua ena hanua ela.

Idia na Serubabele bona Iesua bona Nehemia bona Asaria bona Raamia bona Nahamani bona Morodekai bona Bilsan bona Misperete bona Bigvai bona Nehumu bona Baanaha ida ema. Israel tataudia ihagaudia bini:
Paroso garana, daha-rua sinahu-ta hitu-ahui rua;
Sefatia garana, sinahu-toi hitu-ahui rua;
Ara garana, sinahu-tauratoi imahui rua;
Pahata-moab garana (unu na Iesua bona Ioab garadia), daha-rua sinahu-taurahani gwauta-taurahani;
Elam garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua imahui hani;
Satu garana, sinahu-taurahani hari-ahui ima;
Sakai garana, sinahu-hitu tauratoi-ahui;
Binui garana, sinahu-tauratoi hari-ahui taurahani;
Bebai garana, sinahu-tauratoi ruahui taurahani;
Asgada garana, daha-rua sinahu-toi ruahui rua;
Adonikama garana, sinahu-tauratoi tauratoi-ahui hitu;
Bigvai garana, daha-rua tauratoi-ahui hitu;
Adini garana, sinahutauratoi imahui ima;
Atere garana (unu na Hesekia garana), taurahanita-ahui taurahani;
Hasumu garana, sinahu-toi ruahui taurahani;
Besai garana, sinahu-toi ruahui hani;
Harifi garana, sinahu-ta gwauta-rua;
Gibeon garana, taurahanita-ahui ima;
Betelehem bona Netofa taudia, sinahu-ta taurahani-ahui taurahani;
Anatoto taudia, sinahu-ta ruahui taurahani;
Bet-asamavete taudia, hari-ahui rua;
Kiriat-iearimi bona Kefira bona Beroto taudia, sinahu-hitu hari-ahui toi;
Rama bona Geba taudia, sinahutauratoi ruahui ta;
Mikma taudia, sinahu-ta ruahui rua;
Betele bona Ai taudia, sinahu-ta ruahui toi;
Nebo hanuana ta taudia, imahui rua;
Elam ma ta garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua imahui hani;
Harimi garana, sinahu-toi ruahui;
Ieriko garana, sinahu-toi hari-ahui ima;
Lod bona Hadidi bona Ono garadia, sinahu-hitu ruahui ta;
Senaha garana, daha-toi sinahutaurahanita toi-ahui.
Hahelaḡa taudia: ledaia garana (lesua ena iduhu), sinahu-taurahanita hitu-ahui toi;
Imere garana, daha-ta imahui rua;
Pasahuru garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua hari-ahui hitu;
Harimi garana, daha-ta gwauta-hitu.
Levi taudia: Iesua garana amo Kadmiele garana (hari Kadmiele na Hodeva garana), hitu-ahui hani.
Ane-abi taudia: Asaf garana, sinahu-ta hari-ahui taurahani.
Ikoukou igimadia taudia: Salumu garana, Atere garana, Talmon garana, Akubu garana, Hatita garana, Sobai garana, sinahu-ta toi-ahui taurahani.
Dubu ena hesiai taudia: Siha garana, Hasufa garana, Tabaoto garana,
Kero garana, Sia garana, Padono garana,
Lebana garana, Hagaba garana, Salmai garana,
Hanana garana, Gidele garana, Gahara garana,
Re-aia garana, Resini garana, Nekoda garana,
Gasama garana, Usa garana, Pasea garana,
Besai garana, Meunimi garana, Nefusesimi garana,
Bakabuku garana, Hakufa garana, Harahuru garana,
Basaliti garana, Mehida garana, Harasa garana,
Barako garana, Sisera garana, Tema garana,
Nesia garana, Hatifa garana.
Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia: Sotai garana, Soferete garana, Perida garana,
laala garana, Darakono garana, Gidele garana,
Sefatia garana, Hatili garana, Pokerete-hasabaimi garana, Amon garana.
Dubu ena hesiai taudia bona Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia iboudiai na sinahu-toi taurahanita-ahui rua.
Ini na Tele-mela bona Tele-harasa bona Kerubu bona Adono bona Imere amo ema, a edia iduhu bona senedia ladadia ihamomokanidia asi dibadia, idia na Israel besena taudia eiava lasi:
Delaia garana, Tobia garana, Nekoda garana, sinahu-tauratoi hari-ahui rua.
Hahelaga taudia edia amo danu: Hobaia garana, Hakoso garana, Barasilai garana (una tau ese Barasilai tau Gilead natuna hahinena ta e adavaia, bena idia ladadia ta e henemai).
Idia na ladadia e tahu, lada-tore bukadia ai, to asie davaridia; una dainai hahelaḡa dagina amo e atodia siri, idia na dia ḡoḡoeva dainai.
Hekwara tauna ese e hamaorodia, idia na aniani helaḡa-hereana basie ania, ela bona hahelaḡa tauna ta baine tore isi, Urim bona Tumim
baine nanadaidia.
Hegogo idoinai be taunimanima gerebu-hani
daha-rua sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui,
bona edia hesiai tataudia bona hahinedia danu, daha-hitu sinahu-toi toi-ahui hitu; edia ane-abi tataudia bona hahinedia na sinahu-rua hari-ahui ima.
Edia hosi na sinahu-hitu toi-ahui tauratoi; edia doniki badadia na sinahu-rua hari-ahui ima;
edia kamelo na sinahu-hani toi-ahui ima; bona edia doniki na daha-tauratoi sinahu-hitu ruahui.
Iduhu kwaradia haida ese ḡaukara idurulaina ḡaudia e heni. Hekwara tauna ese gold darikidia daha-ta, nau imahui, bona hahelaḡa taudia edia hahedoki sinahu-ima toi-ahui e heni.
Bona iduhu kwaradia haida ese ḡaukara idurulaina ḡaudia e heni: gold darikidia gerebu-rua bona silver minadia daha-rua sinahu-rua.
Taunimanima oredia e heni ḡaudia be gold darikidia gerebu-rua
bona silver minadia daha-rua, bona hahelaḡa taudia edia hahedoki tauratoi-ahui hitu.

Taunabunai, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia bona ane-abi taudia bona orea taudia haida bona dubu ena hesiai taudia bona Israel idoinai na edia hanua lalodiai e nohova. Hua ihahituna e kau ai Israel taudia iboudiai na edia hanua ai nonoho.

footnotes.text: Urim bona Tumim. Esodo 28, s. 30. ba itaia.
